The rapper recently showed off the new tattoos he’s planning to get while under anesthesia, and fans are already questioning whether this is a decision he’ll end up regretting. While getting tattoos is nothing new for Blueface, the idea of making permanent changes to his body while he’s unconscious has definitely raised some eyebrows.
